name: Delivery and transport concern objection
description: Customer receives a quote then expresses concern about delivery and transport, testing the AI's ability to handle a logistics objection by clarifying delivery options

messages.text: Hi, I'm Lerato. Please send me a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm.
Do you deliver? I'm not sure about transport

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and clarify delivery options or costs
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Logistics objection. AI should confirm delivery availability, explain delivery areas/costs or collection option, and re-attempt a close.
